login.title: Your claims at a glance
login.text: Record doctor and hospital invoices for all three persons and review them per year.
login.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.

newPassword.title: Choose a new password
newPassword.text: Your account was set up with a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.
newPassword.label: New password
newPassword.hint: At least 12 characters, with upper and lower case letters and a number.

mfa.title: Enter your code
mfa.text: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

forgotStep.title: Reset your password
forgotStep.text: Enter your email address. If an account exists, we send you a code.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.text: If an account exists for {{email}}, a code is on its way. Enter it with your new password.

login.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
login.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Please sign in.

errors.invalid_code: That code is not correct. Please try again.
errors.expired_code: That code has expired. Please request a new one.
errors.password_policy: This password is not accepted. Use at least 12 characters with upper and lower case letters and a number.
errors.password_reset_required: Please reset your password to continue.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.session_expired: The sign-in took too long. Please start again.
errors.network: There is no connection to the server. Please check your internet and try again.
errors.unknown: Sign-in did not work. Please try again.

dashboard.title: Claims {{year}}
dashboard.loadError: The data could not be loaded.

empty.title: No claims for {{year}} yet
empty.text: Upload an invoice as a PDF or enter it manually. It will then appear here under the right person.

person.renameError: The name could not be saved.

errors.amount: Please enter an amount greater than 0.
errors.fileType: Please choose a PDF file. Other file types are not supported.
errors.fileSize: The file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.uploadFailed: The upload did not work. Please try again.
errors.saveFailed: The claim could not be saved. Please try again.
errors.deleteFailed: The claim could not be deleted. Please try again.
errors.loadClaimFailed: The claim could not be loaded.
errors.cents: Please enter an amount of 0 or more.
errors.aboveInvoice: Reimbursed and rejected together may not exceed the invoice amount.
errors.amountBelowReimbursed: The amount is lower than what was already reimbursed or rejected.
errors.documentType: Please choose a PDF, JPG or PNG file.
errors.invalidDocument: A file is not a valid PDF, JPG or PNG.
errors.conflict: The claim was changed in the meantime. Please close it and open it again.

mode.label: Type
mode.uploadHint: The data is read from the invoice.
mode.manualHint: Without a PDF, you enter the data yourself.

dialog.confirmDelete: The claim and its PDF file will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
dialog.confirmDiscard: Your changes will be lost. Discard them?
dialog.extractionFailed: The invoice could not be read. Please enter the data yourself.
dialog.dropTitle: Drag a PDF here or choose a file

persons.title: Persons
persons.text: Names and the yearly Selbstbehalt (deductible) of the three persons. The Selbstbehalt is compared with the claims of the selected year on the dashboard.
persons.name: Name
persons.deductibleHint: Leave empty or enter 0 for none.
persons.deductibleInvalid: Please enter an amount of 0 or more, up to 100,000.
persons.saveError: The settings could not be saved. Please try again.

format.title: Date and time
format.text: How dates and times are shown. This is stored in this browser only.

reimbursement.empty: No entries yet. Add one as soon as the insurer responds.
reimbursement.immediate: Entries and documents are saved right away.
reimbursement.confirmDeleteEntry: The entry and its documents will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
reimbursement.confirmDeleteDocument: The document {{name}} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
reimbursement.documentFailed: The document could not be opened. Please try again.
reimbursement.deleteFailed: This could not be deleted. Please try again.
reimbursement.needsSave: Save the claim first, then you can track its reimbursement.

tracking.title: Submission and payment
tracking.submittedHint: Leave empty while the claim has not been submitted.
tracking.paidHint: When you paid the invoice yourself. Leave empty while it is unpaid.

entry.title: Add entry
entry.reimbursedHint: Only the amount of this payment. Several partial reimbursements add up.
entry.dropTitle: Drag a benefit statement or letter here or choose files
entry.dropMeta: PDF, JPG or PNG, 10 MB each at most
entry.saveFailed: The entry could not be saved. Please try again.
